exact_statement: For every finite first-positive comb on a>=1 fresh uniform physical selector coordinates, with actual Boolean leaves g_1,...,g_(a+1) on one common data cube whose entire squared Fourier spectra agree with P, and every prescribed complete data spectral subprobability reference R positive on P-support with finite cost c=CE(P,R), the explicit normalized-row output subprobability reference Q(U,T)=R(T)*sigma_That(U)^2 (a normalized empty-selector kernel on zero P fibers) has mass sum R and exact cost CE(P_F,Q)=c+sum_T P(T)H(sigma_T)<=c+C_* I_sel(F), C_*=4+2/(e ln2)<41/8. Here sigma_T is the physical scalar sign comb with labels g_jhat(T)/sqrt(P(T)). Also I_data(F)=I(g_1), CE(P_F,Q)-H(F)=c-H(g_1), and c<=K I(g_1) yields ideal full cost <=max(K,C_*)I(F). All translates and sign changes of any fixed Boolean core are admitted. Arbitrary terminal core cost and one-word integer rounding <=1 are retained; no universal common-magnitude admission or general magnitude-change payment is asserted.
hypotheses: Uniform finite cubes and Boolean sign leaves; all entropy and cross entropy units bits
a>=1 independent selector coordinates tested once in fixed first-positive order; selectors absent from leaves
Every leaf uses the same physical data cube; arbitrary repetitions and overlap allowed
Entire squared Fourier spectra of the actual leaves agree, including the empty frequency
Fixed full data subprobability reference, positive on true support and of finite cross entropy
Ideal reference costs; ordinary single-output prefix rounding retains a separate additive one
